 27	// ChatSummary compacts settled chat history by asking the side model to
 28	// summarize the older messages, so a long session stays within the main
 29	// model's context window. It is a close port of aider's ChatSummary — recursive
 30	// split: keep a recent tail, summarize the older head, recurse — run
 31	// synchronously by the coder.
 32	type ChatSummary struct {
 33		client llm.ModelClient
 34		side   *config.Model
 35		tokens TokenCounter
 36		out    Output
 37		clock  Clock
 38	}
 39	
 40	// NewChatSummary builds a summarizer backed by the side model. out and clock
 41	// are the same ports the coder talks through, so a compaction retry reports
 42	// and sleeps exactly like a turn's.
 43	func NewChatSummary(client llm.ModelClient, side *config.Model, tokens TokenCounter, out Output, clock Clock) *ChatSummary {
 44		return &ChatSummary{client: client, side: side, tokens: tokens, out: out, clock: clock}
 45	}
 46	
 47	// count estimates one message's tokens, including its tool calls. m.Text()
 48	// reads Content only, so an assistant turn that is all tool calls would
 49	// otherwise count as zero — the same undercount countMessages fixed on the
 50	// send side, where the arguments are often the largest thing in the request.
 51	// In a tool-driven harness that history is exactly the history most worth
 52	// compacting, so the budget that decides when to compact must see it.
 53	func (s *ChatSummary) count(m llm.Message) int {
 54		n := s.tokens.Count(m.Text())
 55		for _, tc := range m.ToolCalls {
 56			n += s.tokens.Count(tc.Name) + s.tokens.Count(tc.Arguments)
 57		}
 58		return n
 59	}
 60	
 61	func (s *ChatSummary) total(msgs []llm.Message) int {
 62		n := 0
 63		for _, m := range msgs {
 64			n += s.count(m)
 65		}
 66		return n
 67	}
 68	
 69	// sideInputBound is how much head the side model can be fed in one call.
 70	func (s *ChatSummary) sideInputBound() int {
 71		if s.side != nil && s.side.Context > 0 {
 72			return s.side.Context
 73		}
 74		return summaryFallbackInput
 75	}
 76	
 77	// tooBig reports whether the messages exceed the history budget.
 78	func (s *ChatSummary) tooBig(msgs []llm.Message, maxTokens int) bool {
 79		return s.total(msgs) > maxTokens
 80	}
